high_level_description: A 1600x900 landscape structural draft of a rural meadow scene with four distinct, large-scale silhouette agents arranged horizontally: a bending woman in floral dress and straw hat on the left, a running golden retriever mid-left, a smaller terrier with leather harness mid-right, and a seated cat on the far right — all on a neutral light background.

style_description.photo: wide landscape framing, structural draft blueprint

compositional_deconstruction.background: uniform light neutral background (#f8f9fa), no terrain features or props

elements.desc: woman bending left: red floral sundress silhouette with yellow straw hat, centered at x=260, full-body pose emphasizing bent torso and skirt flare
golden retriever running: gold oval body with four angled leg segments and floppy ear shapes, oriented left-to-right, centered at x=600, y=600
smaller terrier with leather harness: white compact body silhouette with brown horizontal harness band across chest, centered at x=980, y=610
cat seated upright on right: gray rounded-rectangle body with triangular ears and subtle tail curve, centered at x=1300, y=580
